words.vi: Để thuyết phục ai đó làm điều gì đó
words.en: To persuade someone to do something
words.ex: I had to twist his arm to get him to come along.
Can you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?

words.vi: Trở nên lo lắng trước khi làm điều gì đó
words.en: To become nervous before doing something
words.ex: He got cold feet before the wedding.
Can you give me a hand with these boxes?
Don't worry, I'm just pulling your leg.

words.vi: Để thay đổi quan điểm hoặc cảm xúc của bạn
words.en: To change your opinion or feelings
words.ex: She had a change of heart and decided to stay.

words.vi: Để vẫn vui vẻ trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn
words.en: To remain cheerful in a difficult situation
words.ex: Keep your chin up – things will improve.

words.vi: Vụng về và vụng về với bàn tay của bạn
words.en: Clumsy and awkward with your hands
words.ex: I'm all thumbs when it comes to cooking.

words.w: have your head in the clouds
words.vi: Không thực tế hoặc mơ mộng
words.ex: She has her head in the clouds most of the time.

words.w: by the skin of your teeth
words.vi: Chỉ vừa đủ; trong gang tấc
words.ex: He passed the exam by the skin of his teeth.

words.vi: Để có lập trường vững chắc
words.ex: Eventually she put her foot down and said no.

words.vi: Nói điều gì đó khiến bạn phiền lòng
words.en: To say something that has been troubling you
words.ex: I just needed to get this off my chest.
He's head over heels for his new girlfriend.

words.vi: Lắng nghe một cách thông cảm
words.ex: She always lends an ear when I need to talk.
I'll keep my fingers crossed for your interview.

words.vi: Đủ không gian để di chuyển tự do
words.ex: This office needs more elbow room.
The manager gave the green light for the project.
